source_title: Solidigm Extends AI Portfolio Leadership with the Introduction of 122TB Drive

claim_relevant_segments.capacity_step: the 122TB D5-P5336 doubles the storage space of Solidigm’s earlier 61.44TB version of the drive
claim_relevant_segments.workload_scope: offering an ideal solution for AI and data-intensive workloads

claim_relevant_visible_text:
the 122TB D5-P5336 doubles the storage space of Solidigm’s earlier 61.44TB version of the drive
offering an ideal solution for AI and data-intensive workloads
researcher_paraphrase: Solidigm introduced a 122.88TB QLC data-center SSD, double the capacity of its prior 61.44TB version, positioning it for AI/data-intensive workloads.
precision_guard: This proves a high-density enterprise SSD product milestone and vendor-stated workload positioning. It does not prove installed-base adoption, shipment volume or industry-wide AI NAND demand.
authority_boundary: Solidigm's own newsroom release is primary for its product introduction and positioning.
